messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P1 - continuous-batching throughput crater in us-west-2 reported. Alerts: cont-batch-kv-cascade

Sara: I'm on pager. seeing queue depth skyrocket and microbatch spikes to 512+, many inflight requests queuing.

Mike: grabbing flamegraphs now. looks like kvcache eviction cascade + prefetcher loop. prefetch requests jumping -> lock contention -> more evictions.

Sara: customer impact: multiple Dedicated tenants with 95th/99th latency > 12s and intermittent 5xx errors. cb_queue_depth ~1400, kv_evictions/sec ~3800.

Alex: runbook referenced: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cont-batch-kvcascade

Sara: mitigation plan (rapid): 1) throttle continuous-batch concurrency 2) cap microbatch size 3) apply eviction-throttle flag 4) rate-limit prefetcher

Mike: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T20:03:02Z] scheduler.cpp: queue_depth=1420 microbatch=512 enqueue_delay=98ms
[2026-03-15T20:03:03Z] kv_cache_manager.cpp: evict_burst=412 lock_wait=9ms
[2026-03-15T20:03:04Z] worker.cc: downstream_err=503 code=kv_miss_spike
```

Sara: executing hotpatches now (us-west-2):
```
redwoodctl patch serving-config --region us-west-2 --set continuous_batch.max_inflight=100
redwoodctl patch serving-config --region us-west-2 --set continuous_batch.microbatch_max=64
redwoodctl patch prefetcher --region us-west-2 --set target_rate=150/s
redwoodctl patch kv-cache --region us-west-2 --set eviction.throttle_enabled=true
```

Incident Bot: Changes queued: max_inflight=100 (dpl-9980), microbatch_max=64 (dpl-9981), prefetcher throttled (dpl-9982), eviction throttle toggled (dpl-9983)

Jordan: metrics trending down. queue_depth 1420 -> 260 over last 2 minutes. tail latency improving.

Mike: still seeing residual 503s for one heavy tenant (cust-omega). evictions down to ~550/s.

Sara: opened support ticket for cust-omega (TKT-8921). SRE + support coordinating.

Naga: I have a backup plan to disable prefetcher entirely if spikes persist:
```
redwoodctl patch prefetcher --region us-west-2 --set enabled=false
```

Sara: hold on full disable for now. keeping prefetcher throttled. uploading traces and pprof data to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1768129999/

Mike: uploaded heap profiles + pprof snapshots.

Sara: creating incident doc and tagging "cont-batch-kv-cascade". Handoff notes for night oncall (Alex): actions taken + observed improvements + outstanding cust-omega issue. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1768129999

Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: Alex. Please ack.

Alex: ack. I'll monitor cust-omega and double-check eviction throttle tunables.

Sara: thanks all. paging closed for now; keeping channel open for postmortem write-up. :white_check_mark:
